dedupe_keys.name: eugassc eugasnet and eugasimpact daily eu27 and uk gas supply sources intra eu transmission and consumption drivers 2022 2024

description: This Zenodo dataset, described in a 2025 Earth System Science Data paper, tracks how natural gas supply, transmission and consumption in the EU27 and the UK changed after the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine. Version 2.0 updates EUGasSC, a daily dataset of country- and sector-specific supply sources; adds EUGasNet, daily intra-EU gas transmission with supply sources, built from ENTSOG data and EUGasSC through a flow mass balance simulation; and adds EUGasImpact, daily sector-specific drivers of consumption change from attribution models using several open datasets. Inputs include ENTSOG, ENTSO-E and Eurostat annual and monthly energy balances. The paper reports an 87.8 percent cut in Russian supply during the post-invasion winters, LNG rising from 20.7 to 37.5 percent of supply and a 19.0 percent fall in consumption, attributing most of the drop to household heating behaviour and lower industrial output. Files are available to download free under CC BY 4.0, and the record was last updated on 3 July 2024. Coverage is the EU27 and the UK from 2022 to 2024. Caveats: transmission flows by source are modelled, not metered, and the series stops in 2024. Simulation uses are observed supply shock and rerouting data for validating gas network flow, security of supply and cascading disruption models. Related records: data-entsog-transparency-platform is the main flow source.
